title: My Hero Academia Creator’s New Manga Is Basically Jujutsu Kaisen in My Hero Academia’s Art Style
content: Kohei Horikoshi’s My Hero Academia manga came to an end over two years ago, and as one of the biggest modern manga series to surpass 400 chapters, its absence is still deeply felt. However, the anime kept the series’ momentum alive over the past two years before finally bringing the franchise to a proper close.
author: ComicBook

title: Bunny Drop's Yumi Unita Launches New Manga in September
content: The September issue of Shodensha 's Feel Young magazine revealed last Friday that Yumi Unita will launch a new manga titled Heights Nanten ~2-mei-sama Gentei Desu~ in the magazine's next issue on September 8.
author: ANN

title: Soborou's Jukebox Manga Ends
content: Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket platform published the final part of the final chapter of Soborou 's Jukebox manga on August 1. The third compiled book volume will ship on September 16.
author: ANN

title: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Spinoff Prequel Casts Connie Nielsen, Stana Katic
content: Nexus Point News revealed the spinoff prequel series in November 2025, which will star Wyatt Russell playing young Lee Shaw (his father Kurt Russell played the character in Monarch: Legacy of Monsters ), as well as Millie Brady, Pilou Asbaek, Corey Stoll, Ralph Ineson, and Nyasha Hatendi.
author: ANN

title: Deadline: Live-Action Zelda Film Casts Sam Neill, Dichen Lachman, Yvonne Strahovski, Uli Latukefu
content: Entertainment news website Deadline reported new cast members for the live-action The Legend of Zelda film on August 6 according to its sources, which include the late Sam Neill (the project reportedly concluded filming in April, prior to his death on July 13), Dichen Lachman as Impa, and Yvonne Strahovski as a "queen…

title: One Piece’s Luffy Haunts The World of Shonen Jump in Wild Crossover
content: The legend of the Grand Line has become one of the greatest adventures in anime history, and for good reason. Even decades following One Piece’s debut, shonen fans are still following along with the story of the Straw Hat Pirates as the grand finale continues to play out.
author: ComicBook

title: New Dragon Ball Super Anime Disappoints With Surprise Release Update
content: Dragon Ball Super is now in the works on coming back with a brand new anime for the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc , and an unfortunate update from Toei Animation teases that it’s going to be a much longer wait for fans are hoping for.
author: ComicBook

title: Eren the Southpaw Manga Ends
content: Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ published the final chapter of the new serialization of Kappi and nifuni 's Hidarikiki no Eren ( Eren the Southpaw ) manga on Wednesday. The 26th and final compiled book volume ships on September 4.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Series How Do We Relationship? Reveals 7 More Cast Members
content: The staff for the live-action series adaptation of Tamifull 's How Do We Relationship? ( Tsukiatte Agete mo Ii ka na ) manga unveiled the main visual and seven more cast members on Tuesday.
author: ANN
